shortDescription: CyberArk Authentication using PAS Web Services SDK.

options.name: api_base_url
options.description: A string containing the base URL of the server hosting CyberArk's Privileged Account Security Web Services SDK.

options.name: concurrentSession
options.description: Whether or not to allow concurrent sessions for the same user.

options.name: connection_number
options.description: To support multiple connections for same user specify different value for this parameter.

options.name: cyberark_session
options.description: Dictionary set by a CyberArk authentication containing the different values to perform actions on a logged-on CyberArk session.

options.name: new_password
options.description: The new password of the user. This parameter is optional, and enables you to change a password.

options.name: state
options.description: Specifies if an authentication logon/logoff and a cyberark_session should be added/removed.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Allows you set a timeout for when your authenticating to Cyberark

options.name: use_cyberark_authentication
options.description: Whether or not LDAP will be used.

options.name: use_ldap_authentication
options.description: Whether or not LDAP will be used.

options.name: use_radius_authentication
options.description: Whether or not users will be authenticated via a RADIUS server. Valid values are true/false.

options.name: use_windows_authentication
options.description: Whether or not Windows will be used.

options.name: username
options.description: The name of the user who will logon to the Vault.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), SSL certificates will not be validated.  This should only set to C(false) used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.
